messages.subject: Re: Runapp others ui and server files by a main server file?
parts: You can use uiOutput/renderUI in your main app, and in the renderUI, return a shinyApp object created using shinyAppDir(). Or if you know exactly what the Shiny app will be ahead of time, you can call shinyAppDir() directly in your main app's UI, I believe.
